records.title: RelateOp fails to report interior-interior intersection

original.note: The A hex in JTS #1237 (and #1236) is truncated (104 hex chars; a 3-point EWKB line needs 122) and does not parse; the complete A used here is from strk's geosop command in GEOS #1530 (comment https://github.com/libgeos/geos/issues/1530#issuecomment-5829085530), whose B equals JTS #1237's B.

records.reported: relate(A,B)=FF1F00102 (no interior-interior intersection); geosop crosses=false

records.notes: Upstream JTS #1237 (open). Root cause per dr-jts: RelateOp uses computed intersection points, which round onto B's endpoint. SRID dropped in WKT.
